integrity: The proof is analytic. It uses the exact reset convention and an explicit integrating-factor solution on each reset-free leg; no finite simulation is used as evidence for the infinite-time spike-count statement.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to constant input and initial voltage strictly below the constant-drive equilibrium voltage.
It proves the finite-count part of Conjecture 4.16 on this autonomous subfamily and does not settle genuinely time-dependent periodic forcing.
An equivalent comparison result may exist in older adaptive-threshold or integrate-and-fire literature under different terminology; bounded searches did not locate one.
title: Constant drive restores spike-count monotonicity in the MHR hybrid neuron
